summary: This note describes Elmo, a census-designated place in Lake County, Montana, United States. It gives the Salish name of the place, sqʷe, meaning "inlet in the lake". It reports a population of 143 at the 2000 census.
one_line: Elmo is a census-designated place in Lake County, Montana, with a 2000 population of 143.
key_facts: Elmo is a census-designated place (CDP) in Lake County, Montana, United States.
The population of Elmo was 143 at the 2000 census.
The Salish name for Elmo is sqʷe, which means "inlet in the lake".
